{{Quote|Most recently, Scimitar's new 'vertical swoop' tactics proved especially useful in the assault of the Aturi Cluster, where Rebels had set up powerful anti-atmospheric defenses.|A compilation of Galactic Empire documents by Major Arhul Hextrophon|<ref name="IS2" />}}
The '''Aturi Cluster'''<ref name="IS2" /> was located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Hook Nebula/Legends|Hook Nebula]].<ref name="EAOC" /> At some point by the [[Time/Legends|time]] shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] established formidable anti-[[Atmosphere/Legends|atmospheric]] defenses there. As part of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War's]] [[Hook Nebula campaign]], the [[Qeimet fleet]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] launched an [[Siege of Nulan VI|assault]] on the [[Star cluster/Legends|star cluster]]. During that engagement, the [[Fleet/Legends|fleet's]] [[Scimitar assault wing]], which was [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanded]] by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Tomax Bren/Legends|Tomax Bren]] and utilized [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa tactical bombers]], used its recently developed<ref name="IS2" /> [[Vertical Swoop]] tactic<ref name="Journal15">{{JournalCite|15|Special Military Unit Intelligence Update}}</ref> to great effect. The assault on the Aturi Cluster was subsequently mentioned in a compilation of Imperial documents made by Rebel [[Historian/Legends|historian]] [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Arhul Hextrophon/Legends|Arhul Hextrophon]] for Alliance [[Supreme Commander (Alliance)/Legends|Supreme Commander]] [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] and other Rebel [[Officer/Legends|officers]].<ref name="IS2" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Aturi Cluster was first mentioned in [[Greg Gorden]]'s [[1989]] ''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]'' that was published by [[West End Games]] for use with ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="ISB">''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]''</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' subsequently placed it in grid square O-18.<ref name="TEA" />
